note: Mostly seasonal RV park on a 9-hole golf course off Hwy 371 between Pequot Lakes and Jenkins, with mini golf and a maze. Short stays use the nine open pull-through sites; the golf-course back-ins are wooded and held by seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: rates confirmed ($45 shoulder Sun-Thu to $69 holidays; base $45 passes the gate, peak Sun-Thu $55), 49 full-hookup 50-amp sites, only pull-throughs 23-31 nightly (40 of 49 seasonal and full), request-form booking, season May 1 - Oct 1, showers, Wi-Fi. Google 4.6 (69). Mostly-seasonal flag for the reviewer; pin ~360 m off.
flags: Long-stay (reviewer decides): the operator says 'Sites 1 thru 22 are all seasonal sites and currently full' and 'Sites 32 thru 49 are all seasonal sites and currently full', so only 9 of 49 sites (23-31, 18%) take nightly guests: mostly seasonal. 2027: 'We will be opening short term availability for 2027 in April when we know what is available.' Not iffy: current dated rates for every night type, a posted site map, a booking calendar, Google 4.6 with 69 reviews, RV Life 4 stars/$$. Nothing in the wording turns nightly guests away. Imagery shows the golf-course loops full of rigs, consistent with the stated seasonal fill.

Price gate: the base $45 (Sunday-Thursday, May 1 - June 12 and September) is at or under $50 and passes. Peak Sunday-Thursday is $55, weekends $65 and holidays $69, all over $50. No Good Sam or member discount posted; gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Minneapolis 201 km).

PIN MOVE (~360 m): stored 46.62780,-94.32180 falls on the golf course west of the lodge; Esri imagery puts the RV site loops around 46.6261,-94.3178 (Google's place point 46.626519,-94.318892 is the lodge/office). Move to 46.6261,-94.3178.
